title: DevSecOps & Cloud Security
description: Integrate security into CI/CD pipelines. Learn SAST/DAST, Container Vulnerability Scanning (Trivy), OWASP Top 10 API Security, SBOMs, Secrets Management (Vault), and Zero Trust.
objectives: Implement SAST and DAST security gates in CI/CD
Scan Docker images for CVEs using Trivy
Prevent BOLA & OWASP Top 10 API Security risks
Generate Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) for supply chain security
